'''Garth Ezzar's speeder bike''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] that was owned by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]]. It resembled [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] speeder bike, the [[Bloodfin/Legends|''Bloodfin'']], and was kept aboard [[Garth Ezzar's Sith Infiltrator|Ezzar's Sith Infiltrator]]. He used it during the [[Destruction of the Almas Academy]], where he flew it from his landing point in a ravine on [[Almas]] to the [[Almas Academy]].
